artworks.title: Interior with Three Boys and a Dog
artworks.artist: Sir David Wilkie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior with various objects. The drawing depicts a scene showing an interior space with individuals in casual poses. The central figure is standing, wearing a hat and holding an object. Another individual sits with their back turned in profile and a third is in a relaxed pose near a doorway. The room is filled with containers and simple furnishings. Near the seated individuals, there is a dog. The style of the drawing is characteristic of etching techniques, with fine lines creating depth and texture that bring focus to the interior setting and its occupants.

artworks.title: The Cottage Door
artworks.artist: Sir David Wilkie
artworks.description: The image shows two women and a child standing in a doorway. One woman is inside the doorway, placing her hand on the other woman's shoulder, who is outside holding a child. The woman inside has a rounded face with defined features, wearing a bonnet, long-sleeved dress, and an apron. The woman outside has a solemn expression, wearing a scarf, a plain dress, and a shawl. The child she holds is wearing a bonnet and a long dress. A dog is scratching itself nearby, and a broom, shovel, and potted plants are on the ground. The background shows a rustic wall with hanging laundry, a wooden structure, and vine leaves growing above the doorway.

artworks.title: Reading the Will
artworks.artist: Sir David Wilkie
artworks.description: In this image, a group of people is depicted in an indoor setting gathered around a table. The central figure, an older man, is seated at the table and is wearing spectacles with a receding hairline, revealing a bald top, and is dressed in a long-sleeved coat fastened with buttons. Next to him, another individual holds a jug. Several people are standing behind or seated around the table, one of whom is reading a newspaper. The individuals have varied facial features and hairstyles, and the clothing seems to be from an earlier era, with high collars and hats among the group. On the table, there are quill pens, ink bottles, and possibly a small container. The background is dark, with a wooden door visible on the left side of the image. The setting gives the impression of a gathering in a modest room where the group appears engaged in reading or listening to the contents of the newspaper.

artworks.title: The Lost Receipt
artworks.artist: Sir David Wilkie
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a room. Two are seated at a desk, appearing focused on an activity. The third stands beside them, holding a hat. The figures lack detail in the lower half. They wear long robes or coats and are surrounded by rolled-up papers or canvas. The setting suggests a historical or artistic environment. The background is dimly lit, emphasizing the central activity. The image is enclosed within a border on a worn page, indicating a historical context, possibly from an old book or manuscript.

artworks.title: The Flemish Mother
artworks.artist: Sir David Wilkie
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, with the upper bodies of both visible. A seated adult is turned slightly to the left, looking towards the standing child. The adult has defined facial features partially obscured by the broad brim of a hat, and their hair is not clearly visible. They are dressed in flowing, layered clothing with detailed patterns. Next to them, a child is standing on a chair or raised surface, wearing a round cap and a simple garment with long sleeves. The child appears to be reaching towards the adult's face. On the table beside them is a large decorative jug and a piece of fabric draped over the edge featuring intricate patterns. The setting appears to be an interior with a wooden chair visible behind the adult and a curtain hanging in the background. The artwork itself is bordered by a light paper with some visible foxing and slight water stains at the edges.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an ornate architectural and decorative composition. The image includes two angelic figures on pedestals on each side of a central rectangular panel with Latin text. The angels are depicted in a classical style, holding their hands in a prayer gesture. The text is framed within a complex architectural structure with classical elements such as columns and triangular pediments, adorned with intricate patterns. A small dove is depicted above the main text panel, and a round medallion is positioned below the main frame. The entire composition is shaded to emphasize depth and intricacy, similar to detailed engravings or prints from the early 17th century.

artworks.title: Moses
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image is an artistic engraving showing the upper half of an elderly man's body. He is positioned with his body slightly turned to the right, leaning on a surface, and holding a staff in his right hand. His facial features are prominent with deep-set eyes, a long, flowing beard, and thick, wavy hair that is partially covered by a cloth. He wears a robe with ornamental designs on the sleeves. There is no visible jewelry. The background is filled with fine horizontal lines, within which the figure is enclosed in a circular frame, and textual elements appear above and to the side.

artworks.title: David
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his head slightly tilted downward while gazing to his left, his hand raised and placed on a harp. He has medium-length curly hair and a full beard, with a solemn expression on his face. He wears a detailed robe with patterned sleeves and an elaborate collar adorned with intricate designs. Resting on his head is a grand crown, emphasizing his status. In his hand, he holds a harp. The background has a circular frame with inscriptions and decorative geometric shapes.

artworks.title: Isaias
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in profile view from the waist up. He has a long white beard, short hair, and wears a patterned robe with layered sleeves. His left hand is gesturing, and his right hand holds a writing implement over a surface. The background includes a circular border with inscriptions and Latin text, set against a finely hatched texture.

artworks.title: Jeremiah
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image features the upper body of a person in a seated pose. The person has their hands clasped together in front of their chin, with their eyes gazing upwards. They have a long beard, deep-set eyes, long, wavy hair flowing down to the shoulders, and wear a draped garment resembling a robe. The background includes a circular frame with Latin inscriptions. The image has a textured, engraved appearance.

artworks.title: Baruch
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man framed within an oval. The man is depicted seated with his body slightly turned to his right but facing forward. He has curly, short hair and a full beard showing intricate detailing. He is wearing a robe with a visible collar and decorative trims, featuring elaborate patterns and button details. The man is gesturing with his right hand palm facing up, while his left hand is resting on an unseen surface. Above him, the name "Baruch" is engraved in the surrounding border within an elaborate frame. Simple lines fill the background.

artworks.title: Ezechial
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile, looking slightly upwards. The individual has curly hair and is wearing a headscarf. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a focused expression. They are wearing a loose-fitting garment with a wide collar featuring decorative patterns. Both hands are visible in a gesture of clasping or praying. The background is a textured surface within an oval frame, giving a classical style to the illustration. No jewelry or additional objects are present.

artworks.title: Daniel
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a waist-up portrait of a person with long, curly hair, seen in profile with their body slightly turned to the side. They are dressed in a loose robe, have a prominent nose, and are looking towards the right. The person's right hand is raised near their chest, while the left hand rests on a surface in front of them. The background features an oval border framing the portrait. The name "DANIEL" is inscribed above the person within the oval, and there is Latin text around the border. The image is rendered in a monochromatic, etched style.

artworks.title: Hosiah
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right, with one hand raised as if gesturing. His facial features include a beard and mustache, with deep set eyes and a strong nose, and his hair is curly and appears to go partway down his neck. He is wearing a cloak with a hood that is pulled over his head, and a buttoned garment underneath. He is surrounded by a circular frame with text on it, and the background is a plain, shaded texture with additional text above his head reading "OSEE."

artworks.title: Joel
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is positioned in a half-length side profile, facing to the left. The man's facial features include a prominent nose, a thoughtful expression, and a curly beard. He has curly hair peeking out from under a headband. He is wearing a draped garment. His right hand is resting on a ledge or railing in front of him, with the fingers partially curled. The portrait is framed by an oval border, with text written along its edges. The background inside the frame is plain.

artworks.title: Amos
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image depicts a man named Amos. He is shown in a half-body view, facing slightly to his left. Amos is seated or in a leaning posture, holding a rod or staff in his right hand. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a full beard, and mustache. He has short, wavy hair and is dressed in a cloak over a tunic with visible folds. There is an elliptical frame around him with text along the edges. The background is plain and lightly shaded, emphasizing the figure within the engraved border.

artworks.title: Abdias
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting an upper body portrait of a person seated and facing slightly to their right. The person has distinct facial features, curly hair mostly covered by a cap or headpiece, and is dressed in layered clothing with detailed folds. Their hands are positioned in front of them. In the background, there is a circular border with Latin text. The style of the engraving is detailed and textured.

artworks.title: Ionas
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image portrays a man's upper body, featuring his chest and head. He faces slightly left with his head turned forward. The man has a beard, mustache, and wavy hair around his face. His eyes are looking upwards with a thoughtful expression, detailed with engraved lines. He wears a garment with a wide collar and a robe or cloak. His right hand is raised to his chest, fingers spread, while his left hand rests on a ledge in front of him, fingers slightly curved. Latin inscriptions surround the figure within a circular frame in the background, which is shaded with lines for texture. No jewelry or other objects are present.

artworks.title: Michaeas
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of an individual in profile, facing left. The person has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, visible cheekbone, and defined chin, with slightly curly hair under a cap. They are dressed in ornate clothing and holding a rectangular object. The background is plain with a circular design framing the person, and the name "MICHAEAS" is inscribed above with Latin text. The engraving showcases detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Nahum
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated person with their head slightly tilted downward and eyes closed. The person has distinct facial features, including a rounded face, softly contoured cheeks, a small mouth, and short curly hair. They are wearing an ornate gown with visible buttons down the front and folds that give it a voluminous look. The person is holding a rolled-up scroll in their left hand, resting on a surface. The background has an oval frame around the figure with inscriptions and the name "NAHUM" at the top. The engraving features detailed lines in a classical or historical artistic style.

artworks.title: Habachuch
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is an image of a person seated, shown from the waist up. The individual's head is turned slightly upwards to their left. They have strong facial features with long, wavy hair. The person is wearing a flowing robe and one hand is raised to the chest while the other rests in front. There is a decorative band or ring on the raised hand. The background features an oval border framing the person, surrounded by text at the top and sides.

artworks.title: Sophonias
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man within an oval frame, depicting his upper body down to his forearms. He faces forward with a slight upward tilt of his head. The man has a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, a defined nose, and a full beard. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair partially tucked under a cap decorated with a ribbon and a round ornament. He wears a loose garment with a visible undergarment, and holds a piece of fabric in one hand resting on a ledge. The background is plain, with engraved text, including the name "SOPHONIAS," and smaller inscriptions around the frame.

artworks.title: Aggaeus
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a person's upper body in a half-length portrait. The person appears with their head slightly tilted downward and to the side, eyes closed. Their facial features include a detailed face with an aquiline nose and slightly parted lips, framed by curly, shoulder-length hair. The person wears a textured garment with intricate patterns on one side and a simpler fabric on the other, with a voluminous sleeve extending beyond the frame. They are illustrated resting an elbow on a surface and holding a pen. The background features an oval frame with engraved text surrounding it.

artworks.title: Zaccarias
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view of a person identified as Zacharias. He is depicted sitting down, with his upper body turned slightly to the left. The person has a contemplative expression, with well-defined features, including a prominent nose and slightly downturned eyes, framed by curly hair peeking out from under a head wrap. He is wearing a robe and a cloak draped over his shoulders, both of which have a heavy fabric texture. The head wrap is patterned with embellishments. His left hand is resting on a book with his fingers gripping its open pages, while his right hand holds up the book. The background is a textured oval frame, with inscriptions in Latin encircling it, and shaded with fine lines for depth.
